# Sound kits: every role, sound and placement rule

<!-- generated by remotion-engine/assets/engine/scripts/kit-docs.mjs from sfx-pack/ — do not edit by hand -->

The sounds come from [earshot](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot) (MIT; bank `forge_v2r6+forge04r1+fit1+pluck1`), pre-rendered into the engine's
`sfx-pack/` with their measured sync points. Pick a kit in DESIGN.md (`audio.sfx.kit`), audition it with
`node .motion-graphics/mg.mjs sfx --kit <name>`, and override single roles with `audio.sfx.roles`.

**Columns.** *align*: the point of the sound placed on the event (onset = its attack, peak = its loudest 5 ms).
*offset*: where that point lands against the frame (negative = leads the picture). *over bed*: the effect's loudest
50 ms over the music's level in the second before (used when the video has music). *level*: the role's level when
there is no music (dB, loudest role at 0). *gap*: minimum spacing in a run (closer events are skipped). Placement
and level numbers are medians earshot measured on professional launch films; every kit uses them unless its own
role says otherwise.

## Events → roles (defaults; override with `audio.sfx.events`)

| event | fires when | role |
|---|---|---|
| `scene_in` | a scene starts | — (silent) |
| `label_in` | a tag / label glitches in | `tick` |
| `word_in` | each word of a words reveal | — (silent) |
| `words_done` | a words reveal has fully resolved | `text` |
| `decode_start` | a hero starts scrambling | `tick.crisp` |
| `decode_land` | a HERO decode locks | `hit` |
| `decode_land_minor` | a non-hero decode locks | `land.light` |
| `type_char` | a typed character | `key` |
| `type_space` | a typed space | `key.space` |
| `type_done` | typing finished | `click.confirm` |
| `count_tick` | a counter step | `tick` |
| `count_land` | the counter's final number | `land` |
| `strike` | a strike-through draws | `whoosh.short` |
| `fade_in` | an element fades / pops in | `pop` |
| `logo_in` | the end-card logo | `hit` |
| `exit` | a scene starts dimming | — (silent) |
| `transition` | a glitch / flash cut (the cut frame) | `whoosh.short` |

Scene extras in CHOREOGRAPHY.md: `sfx: [{ role: riser, at_s: 3.0 }, { role: bell, at_s: 1.2, note: E5 }, { id: impact_punch, at_s: 2 }]`.
`at_s` is the moment the sound should LAND (its aligned point), not where the file starts: a riser at the hero's time peaks into it.

## `studio`

The professional default: clean, drum-free UI sound for kinetic type and product films. Real CC0 recordings fitted as code for keys, clicks, the bamboo touch and the swish; rounded tonal pops; a warm struck tine for hero moments, tuned into the music key; air risers and breath swells. No kicks, sub thumps, sub drops or noise hats: every short sound keeps under 30 % of its energy below 150 Hz.

Music stop-down before: whoosh.long, swell (depth 5–7 dB, 0.25–0.35 s, back on the hit).

## `launch`

The music-led launch film: soft, short, mid-register effects mixed against the music bed instead of at a fixed level. Every role names its level over the bed (bed_db: the mix's loudest 50 ms at the effect over the music's median 50 ms level in the second before the cue), where it sits against the cut (offset_ms: taps, knocks and clicks lead, pop-in thumps and whoosh and swell peaks land after) and how close a run may go (min_gap_ms); ticks and bells are set wide. The numbers are medians measured on a private set of licensed reference clips; the members are the earshot 0.4 recipe sounds made for that style (ui_pop, knock, cut_hit, mallet, shutter, the thump-whoosh, the dark riser and swell, the mid ding). level_db is the same balance for a mixer without a bed (the loudest role at 0 dB). One gesture at a time: the music steps down before a hit, a drop, a big whoosh or a swell and comes back on it; nothing ducks under the effects. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).

Music stop-down before: hit, whoosh.long, swell (depth 6–12 dB, 0.3–0.5 s, back on the hit).

| role | sound | takes | align | offset ms | over bed dB | level dB | gap ms | notes |

## `calm`

The default for text-led films: soft natural touches, one tuned voice for bells and text, gentle air for moves, a single struck note for the lockup. Clicks, ticks, the pop, the snap, the space bar and the short whoosh are CC0 recordings fitted as code, where they measure closer to their role than the forge member (earshot match against the role's description and against synth-blip descriptions, earshot realness); the other touches are forge taps, the tuned voice is the launch film's measured kalimba. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Riser, swell, suck and drop are off: a reveal resolves on one element. Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).

## `crisp`

Energetic dev-tool and product films: tight UI ticks and clicks, fast air for moves, one clean gated hit, a short tuned sub drop. Designed members where the idiom is designed (the crisp tick, the gated hit, the sub drop, the bell and confirm dings); clicks, ticks, keys, the snap and the light touches are CC0 recordings fitted as code, where they measure closer to their role than the forge member. Every take passes the model-free audit. Riser, swell and suck are off. Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).

## `minimal`

Designed, sub-led, effects-only films (no music bed): airy digital ticks, low sub swells for moves, one sub-led hit, the designed sub drop, high-passed key ticks. The light touch, the text touch and the snap are CC0 recordings fitted as code: the designed taps and knock they replace read as synth blips to earshot match (p 0.01-0.27 for their role against synth-blip descriptions). Every take passes the model-free audit. Riser, swell and suck are off. Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).
